1.title: AI Will Build Totally New Drugs by 2031 | Sam Rodriques
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Sam Rodriques (Edison Scientific CEO) discusses Pfizer partnership deploying AI agents (Robin, Cosmos) for drug discovery; covers drug repurposing as near-term path vs. AI-designed compounds, and clinical timeline realities.

2.title: Local AI Will Take Over Within One Year | Ian Weinberg
2.author: MTS
2.hook: AMD engineer demos Ryzen AI Halo with 192GB unified memory running 300B-parameter models locally; discusses semantic routing as a mechanism to route 70% of enterprise reasoning tasks from frontier models to on-prem silicon.
